title: Isodiametric bound for centrally symmetric sets
statement: For every d ∈ ℕ and every set K ⊆ ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) such that −x ∈ K whenever x ∈ K (no measurability or boundedness assumed): L^d(K) ≤ ω_d·(ediam K/2)^d in [0, ∞]. Here L^d = volume, ω_d = unitBallVolume d = L^d(ball(0, 1)), and ediam is the extended diameter.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid d)), (∀ x ∈ K, -x ∈ K) → volume K ≤ unitBallVolume d * (ediam K / 2) ^ d
